candidates.change_summary: Change the require amount from 10 ether to 9 ether so fallback can be called with a different value.
Delete the require for block.timestamp so the function can be called multiple times in the same block.
Delete the update of pastBlockTime so the timestamp guard is effectively bypassed after first call.
Change the modulus divisor from 15 to 14 so the transfer condition triggers on different block numbers.
Delete the if-condition so the entire balance is always transferred on every successful fallback call.
